item.title: WPL 2026: 3 franchises that can target Sophie Ecclestone in the mega auction
item.description: Sophie Ecclestone is expected to be a hot property in the WPL 2026 auction. Ecclestone was released by UP Warriorz ahead of WPL 2026.

item.title: WATCH: Aiden Markram plucks a one-handed blinder to dismiss Nitish Reddy on Day 3 of second Test – IND vs SA
item.description: Aiden Markram took a spectacular catch on Day 3 of the second Test between India and South Africa. Markram's outstanding effort cut short the innings of Nitish Reddy.

item.title: WPL 2026: 3 franchises that can target Pratika Rawal in the Women’s Premier League mega-auction
item.description: Pratika Rawal is set to be one of the most heavily bid-for national players in the WPL 2026 Mega Auction. Rawal who went unsold in the WPL 2025 auction has had a spectacular year, culminating in her international debut.

item.title: Fans left boiling after India shows disastrous batting against South Africa on Day 3 of the Guwahati Test
item.description: India suffered a batting collapse against Day 3 of the Guwahati Test against South Africa. South Africa captain Temba Bavuma declined to enforce the follow-on after bowling India out for 201.

item.title: Fans erupt as Marco Jansen’s bowling masterclass puts South Africa in driving seat on Day 3 of second Test against India
item.description: South Africa stamped their authority on Day 3 of the second Test against India in Guwahati. Marco Jansen destroyed the hosts with a brilliant display of fast bowling.

item.title: Dharmendra’s passing: From Harbhajan Singh to Suresh Raina – Indian cricket fraternity mourns the demise of Bollywood legend
item.description: Veteran Bollywood legend Dharmendra passed away on Monday morning at his Mumbai residence at age of 89. The Indian cricket fraternity paid heartfelt tributes to the Indian legend.

item.title: WPL 2026: Complete list of players to register for Women’s Premier League mega auction with their base price
item.description: WPL 2026 Mega Auction will brings together 277 registered players fighting for just 73 vacancies across five teams. New Delhi is gearing up for a major showdown on November 27.

item.title: IND vs SA: Karun Nair’s cryptic post ignites selection debate amid India’s batting collapse on Day 3 of Guwahati Test
item.description: Karun Nair posted a cryptic message on social media amid Team India's struggle on Day 3 of second Test. India’s only notable resistance came from a gritty 72-run partnership between Washington Sundar and Kuldeep Yadav.

item.title: WPL 2026: 3 franchises that can target Amelia Kerr in the mega auction
item.description: New Zealand star Amelia Kerr is expected to raise the bar in the WPL 2026 mega auction. Kerr was released ahead of the auction by Mumbai Indians.
